ov: ذنبي (بالإسبانية: Culpa Mia وبالإنجليزية: My Fault) هو فلم دراما رومانسية إسباني صدر عام 2023 من إخراج دومينغو جونزاليس في أول فيلم روائي طويل له وبطولة نيكول والاس وغابريل غيفارا . يستند إلى قصة واتباد التي تحمل نفس الاسم بقلم مرسيدس رون.
plotEn:
Seventeen-year-old Noah has to move into a wealthy new home after her mother Rafaella marries billionaire William Leister. Upset about being separated from her boyfriend Dan, she struggles to adjust to the change and immediately clashes with her new stepbrother, Nick Leister, and the family dog Thor. There is, however, obvious sexual tension when he teases her about her freckles, and when her friend Betty asks her on the phone if her stepbrother is hot, she does not deny it.
That evening, Noah is taken to the Leisters' country club for dinner. Although her closet is full of expensive new clothes, she opts for wearing an over-sized Ramones t-shirt. Noah notices a waitress attempt to seduce Nick and intent on picking an argument, she taunts him about being a trust fund baby. An irritated Nick excuses himself saying he has important work to do, but William asks his son to drop Noah off at home first, hoping they will bond.
On the way, Noah touches a nerve with the topic of mothers, so Nick forces her out of the car. Abandoned on the lonely road, she befriends a partygoer named Mario. Nick turns out to be the leader of the party, where Noah looks on in disgust as he makes out with multiple women. Noah calls Nick out on his pretense of being the perfect son, though he acts unbothered and makes strongly flirtatious remarks.
Noah meets Nick's old friend Jenna and they get along well. Nick acts rebellious by licking shots off Anna's chest, but his attention shifts to a party-crasher
